premises.text: Existing products can find a place or an event, but none composes what goes together for an occasion
premises.evidence_span: there's not a single product on the market today that can tell you what places and what events go together for your occasion

premises.text: Interviews show people plan social occasions by mood and by who is coming
premises.evidence_span: most people, when planning any social occasion, think of two things. What's my mood and who's coming with me?

premises.text: An algorithmic engine searches thousands of places and events in real time, classifying, ranking, and composing plans on the fly
premises.evidence_span: looking at thousands of places and events, algorithmically classifying them, ranking them, and on the fly, composing them into itineraries

premises.text: Plans arrive with review snippets, directions, and booking links so decisions are immediate
premises.evidence_span: Everything is here in review snippets with links out

premises.text: Users own the plan: they can customize it and pull in friends for advice who add places in real time
premises.evidence_span: the minute I delete it, this thing's mine

premises.text: A finished plan becomes a Facebook event in under two seconds with booking links attached
premises.evidence_span: making a Facebook event on WIATA is that it's even easier than making a Facebook event on Facebook site itself

value.text: People get their evening planned for them — what to do tonight without the hassle
value.evidence_span: It solves the problem of what to do tonight. It also takes all the hassle out of planning it

causal_links.evidence_span: It solves the problem of what to do tonight
It made our evening for us
